ns2:section.sectionText: Students must register for the lecture and one lab section. Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system will allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites. You will be dropped from the course when pre-reqs are checked.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or News-Editorial major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
